name: VoISDF Volume Rendering and Adaptive Sampling
aliases: Volume Rendering of Neural Implicit Surfaces
Volume Rendering of Neural Implicit Surfaces training
definition: A volume rendering method for neural implicit surfaces that uses a signed distance function (SDF) to define density and employs an adaptive sampling algorithm based on a theoretical error bound for the opacity approximation, avoiding the need for a second network or random sampling artifacts.
summary: VoISDF is a neural volume rendering method that models density via a Signed Distance Function to extract well-defined surfaces and uses theoretical error bounds to drive adaptive sampling.
